rom.scope: Nine-clock GK104/GM107 BIOS clock-state table only; labels cross-checked with GTX 690 and the supplied edited GM107 ROM. Nouveau source names refer to GK104. Stored frequencies do not establish live clocks, writable controls, NVAPI domain IDs, or factory settings.

protocol: Four samples per state, two temporary ForcePstate(0,2) holds with idle and CUDA-loaded measurements and ForcePstate(16,2) release in finally. No voltage/fan/offset/ROM writes. Labels in samples are the original pre-crosscheck labels; the accompanying Markdown gives the new interpretation.
